summaryZh: Patel Lab 研究肿瘤免疫微环境的空间背景，并开展癌症免疫治疗的早期临床试验与标志物开发。实验室结合空间蛋白、转录与基因组分析、NanoString 平台、深度学习和统计计算。
researchQuestions: 基质与免疫空间构型在抗肿瘤反应中发挥什么作用？

evidence.quote: Patel Lab Dr. Sandip Patel focuses on early phase clinical trials of cancer immunotherapy
Human and murine tumor samples are analyzed in our lab with the NanoString GeoMX DSP Spatial Profiling Microscope and nCounter Max systems
Spatial proteomics, transcriptomics, and genomics are key in our analyses
deep learning of spatial information with advanced statistical methods and computer vision.
computational immunopathology methods to integrate spatial context into a better understanding of the tumor immune microenvironment.
Moores Cancer Center Moores Cancer Center UC San Diego
Kipps Lab Patel Lab Simeone Lab

Human and murine tumor samples are analyzed in our lab with the NanoString GeoMX DSP Spatial Profiling Microscope and nCounter Max systems, and high dimensional data is analyzed in conjunction with clinical factors to elucidate the role of the stromal and immune contexture on anti-tumor responses.
